rule: Sorted held-out first/middle/last; no quality ranking
comparison_rgb_difference: Mean absolute channel difference to M0; fixed display interval [0, 0.1] for every scene/method
depth: [0, scene frozen depth_trunc] shared by methods
surface_camera: M0 post-mesh bounding-box center and 1.1 diagonal distance, first sorted held-out orientation plus 25-degree y-axis yaw, 720x720 60-degree FoV
surface_display: All real triangles via CPU raycast; same camera and lighting for M0/M1/M2
provenance_limit: Supplementary display rule recorded after inspecting M0 visualizations. It is not a preregistered primary evaluation camera. Metric cameras and TSDF remain frozen.
